name: EPIC 212412193

text.card: A red giant 2,715 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.87 solar masses and 11.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,542 K at its surface.
